name: 原则：类型系统纪律
description_zh: 设计类型、审查函数签名、或用任何静态类型语言写代码时：让非法状态不可表示、给语义原语打标、在边界解析外部数据、穷尽变体、从权威 schema 推导。
description_en: Apply when designing types, reviewing a function signature, or writing code in any statically-typed language. Make illegal states unrepresentable, brand semantic primitives, parse external data at boundaries, exhaust variants, derive from authoritative schemas.
